items.statement: The investigation is scientifically reproducible within its declared search scope because candidate generation, validation, energy convention, deduplication, and stopping are documented.
items.expected: The submitted record makes the explored hypothesis space and its limitations auditable at candidate level.

items.statement: Within the isolated neutral 1:1 molecular model, the validated low-energy structures support stable imidazole–salicylic-acid hydrogen-bonded association, while the result does not establish device-interface or solution free energies.
items.expected: The final conclusion connects the computed validated minima and interaction energies to hydrogen-bonded association and explicitly states gas-phase/model limitations.
